thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPEN (P1) - gpu-decode OOM spikes on svc-decode-stream, beginning diagnostics

alice: seeing a big surge in 5xxs and dropped streams starting ~2512345600. logs show repeated CUDA OOM during decode step. tagging oncall.

sanjay: i can repro locally against canary, looks like some requests are hitting extremely long generations — max_tokens seems unset for a new routing rule.

maria: customer reports docs ingestion flows got dropped. their org_id=org-842. they say ~10% of requests failing since ~07:40 UTC.

tony_oncall: acknowledged, stepping in. grabbing node lists and pods.

alice: dump of recent restart reasons from k8s: 
```
$ kubectl get pods -l app=svc-decode-stream -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.status.containerStatuses[0].state.terminated.reason}\n{end}'
stream-decode-5b9d4 CrashLoopBackOff
stream-decode-6a12f OOMKilled
stream-decode-7c3ef Running
```

sanjay: grabbing logs, here's repeating stack tail: 
```
E CudaDriver: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: out of memory
E DecodeWorker: failed to allocate KV cache size=1.2G
W RequestHandler: streaming generation aborted, dropping request
```

maria: customer-sre pinged: "we saw about 200 failed streams in last 10m, some went to 504s" :frowning:

tony_oncall: initial mitigations: 1) enable extra throttling to 50 rps per org, 2) route org-842 to smaller model variant (gpt-small-quant) 3) kill tasks consuming >3x normal tokens. applying now.

alice: throttling applied via rate-limiter, rules: 
```
- org: org-842
  max_rps: 50
  enforced: true
```

ops-bot: Route switch for org-842 -> gpt-small-quant applied on svc-router (rev v2026.2).

sanjay: confirmed several nodes dropped non-evictable GPU allocs from runaway sessions. root cause looks like a config change in routing service that left `max_tokens` unset for some legacy client type, effectively allowing unbounded generation. i found this PR: `deploys/2026-03-15/route-defaults` with a default patch: `max_tokens: null` -> oops.

maria: can we patch the config to enforce a safe upper bound (2048) and restart?

tony_oncall: doing hotpatch: updating config map `route-defaults` to include `max_tokens: 2048` and `stream_timeout: 60s`, rolling out to all router replicas.

alice: pushing a temporary guard in decode service too to reject >2048 tokens at ingress. patch: 
```
if request.max_tokens == nil || request.max_tokens > 2048:
  request.max_tokens = 2048
```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Hotpatch deployed to routers and decode ingress (canary then rollout).

sanjay: after hotpatch: OOM events dropped sharply. GPU memory pressure back to normal baseline. metrics: decode OOM count from 60/min -> 3/min in 10m.

maria: customer-sre confirms declines in failures, "we see decreases in dropped streams after routing change" — they want formal RCA.

alice: immediate customer impact: org-842 experienced elevated error rate and ~200 dropped streams, estimated 0.6% of global traffic during window, no data exfiltration. flagged as P1 due to customer-visible failures.

tony_oncall: followups: 1) revert the accidental `max_tokens:null` change, 2) add CI lint to require default max_tokens <= 4096, 3) add org-level emergency routing to auto-fallback to smaller models, 4) postmortem and customer comms.

sanjay: filing rollback PR and CI lint now. PR link: https://git.internal/repo/route-defaults/pull/582 (hotfix + validation).

maria: tagging customer-sre for comms and impact numbers to ops. customer-sre: please confirm message to customer and SLA credits if any.

customer-sre: we'll draft a message, offering incident summary, mitigation steps, and monitoring updates. no SLA credit expected but will follow up if they escalate.

alice: postmortem action items added to backlog: 
- add server-side hard token cap enforcement at decode runtime (non-config)
- improve anomaly alerting on sustained per-org OOMs
- track per-org peak token length distribution in grafana
- require config PRs to include explicit token bounds

tony_oncall: closing incident after observation window. will watch for recurrences for 24h. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT RESOLVED (P1) - 2512345900 - cause: config regression left max_tokens unset -> runaway generation -> GPU OOM -> request drops. mitigation: throttling, route fallback, hotpatch to enforce `max_tokens=2048`.

alice: thanks everyone. I'll start the RCA doc and link to this thread.

sanjay: adding logs and kubectl outputs to the incident ticket for posterity.

tony_oncall: handing back to ops rotation. oncall cleared.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0315-042. Postmortem assigned to alice, due 72h.
